halt_guidance.blocker: CEL-seq2 needs the experiment-specific well-barcode list, plate-to-sample map, and confirmed barcode/UMI coordinates before reads can be assigned safely.
required_inputs: Well barcode sequences and plate/well-to-sample manifest
Confirmed barcode, UMI, and cDNA read coordinates plus strandedness
next_steps: Recover the well barcode and plate manifest from study supplements or authors.
Confirm read roles and barcode/UMI coordinates against representative FASTQ sequences.
Run zUMIs or an explicitly configured STARsolo workflow and validate the expected wells before accepting the matrix.
halt_guidance.resume: After supplying and validating the plate manifest and exact geometry, an explicit CEL-seq2 STARsolo target can be prepared; do not remove the halt solely from the platform label.
